svg.text: MAIN SLOPE · falls 11.4 m to the east (38%)
CROSS SLOPE · falls 2.6 m to the south (15%)
C10 · The house on the field
Colours = natural ground height from the survey. Outlines = the three floors, each further east than the one above.
A–A to D–D: the four section cuts
show where the natural ground is exactly at the main-floor level (blue) and the
lower-floor level (brown). West of a line that floor is under ground; east of it the
floor is in the open air.
because the field also falls to the south. The lower-floor line is 16.2 m from the
west on the north side but only 10.5 m on the south side. So the south and east
sides of the lower floor are open, and its north-west is buried.
Bedrooms, lounge and terraces sit east and south of the lines. Stair, bathrooms,
laundry and stores sit west of them.
